# mlorente.dev

> Manu Lorente's personal site. SRE & AI Platform Engineer: from silicon to cloud, he designs and runs platforms with Kubernetes, AWS, GCP and GitOps, with AI agents in the workflow.

## About

Manu Lorente has over ten years of engineering, working with customers across Europe, Asia and the US. He started in hardware: automated CMOS sensor testing, firmware for vision cameras and hardware integration with customers, at e2v and then at Teledyne Technologies from 2019. He now builds the platform layer: KubeLab, his own hybrid Kubernetes platform, and the harness his AI agents work in.

## Site Structure

- / — Home: career and studies timeline, skills by layer with a link that proves each one, GitHub activity, latest notes, and a way to get in touch.
- /lab/ — KubeLab: hybrid platform on Hetzner, Google Cloud and a bare-metal homelab, its topology and services, and who can reach each service, measured from outside the mesh and re-checked weekly.
- /ai/ — How his AI agents work: each rule backed by a mechanism (an isolated Git worktree per agent, flock locking, secret redaction, a second model reviewing every pull request, and nothing merged before he reads it).
- /projects/ — Open-source projects, each with the problem, the solution and a link to the code.
- /notes/ — Technical notes on platforms, Kubernetes, networking and GitOps. Written in English.
- /contact/ — Get in touch by email: companies, individuals or a one-off need; he replies within 24 hours.
- /es/ — The Spanish version of the home, /lab/, /ai/ and /contact/.

## Core Engineering Domains

Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, Kubernetes (K3s), GitOps (Argo CD), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible), AWS, Google Cloud, Observability (Prometheus, Grafana), tested backups and restore drills, AI agent harnesses and MCP servers, local LLM inference (Jetson Nano), Networking (WireGuard, Headscale/Tailscale, Split DNS), Zero-Trust access (Authelia, CrowdSec), Go, Python, C, C++, FPGA and embedded firmware.

## Flagship Systems

- KubeLab: his hybrid platform, where this site is deployed.
- AI agent harness: the rules and mechanisms his coding agents work under.
- Hive: open-source MCP server that gives agents the context each task needs.
- Pollex: local LLM inference on a Jetson Nano.
